item.title: 2027's Most Stylish Action Game Looks Spectacular in First Official Gameplay
item.description: Tsarevna was announced last year , and immediately grabbed our attention. Billed as the "world's first ballet-inspired" action game on its Steam page , it features motion capture from real-life ballerina Alyona Kovalyova for its hack-and-slash gameplay. In a new gameplay trailer released Tuesday, that ballet action is on full display, making Tsarevna shoot up my list of most anticipated 2027 games.

item.title: Batman Just Officially Saved DC Comics From a Terrible Fate
item.description: Business mergers always come with shake-ups, and Skydance's recent acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery was inevitably going to be messy in some way. What was unexpected, however, was this week's announcement that James Gunn and Peter Safran would be stepping down as co-heads of DC Studios . At the same time, Skydance has initiated layoffs in other divisions such as Skydance Games . One area that seems to have escaped the chopping block for now, though, is DC Comics.

item.title: How to unlock Fire Arrows in Zelda Ocarina of Time
item.description: Unlocking Fire Arrows is a great way to expand Link's arsenal in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. By hitting targets with these special arrows, Link can set them on fire, which is fairly useful in different scenarios, from fighting certain enemies to lighting totems to open doors. Before you can get your hands on them, you will need to progress through the story and solve a riddle.

item.title: Target's New 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary Drawing Is A Must-See For TCG Fans
item.description: Pokémon fans were thrilled to hear about Target's new trading card game raffle system , which gives collectors a fairer chance to secure products against retail bots. The retailer initially debuted the drawing system with a small three-pack of an older Pokémon set, Destined Rivals. Now, however, Target has begun raffling out two products fans were hoping for all along: the 30th Anniversary TCG set , and the Ascended Heroes set.

item.title: PlayStation Plus November Games Lineup Officially Announced, Includes Death Stranding 2
item.description: On Tuesday, Sony Interactive Entertainment revealed the lineup of games joining the PlayStation Plus Game Catalog in November. Death Stranding 2: On the Beach , Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii , Dragon Quest 3 HD-2D Remake , and more will be available to play on Sony's subscription service.

item.title: Costco’s New 'Pokémon' 30th Anniversary Bundle Is An Unbelievable Deal
item.description: Warehouse retailer Costco is determined to blow its competitors out of the water when it comes to selling Pokémon Trading Card Game products. A couple of months after debuting the best Pokémon deal of 2026 , the members-only retailer is back with another offer that sounds too good to be true. This time, Costco's promotion targets Pokémon collectors hunting for the elusive 30th Anniversary collection .

item.title: Doomsday Officially Comes to Marvel Rivals With an X-Men Icon
item.description: As usual with Marvel Rivals , it seems NetEase’s hints about the game's next hero panned out. Nightcrawler is on the way. He's releasing Season 11: Doomsday, which will be out on Nov. 13. The animated trailer revealing this beloved X-Man does a great job of conveying the character’s selflessness as he warps to and fro to save as many innocent bystanders as he can before getting hit by an airplane. Is it a little on the nose when he warps onto a cross as the sun filters in like a Renaissance painting? Yes, but it goes very hard. Nightcrawler’s official announcement comes after NetEase teased his appearance in the Gallery Card hints, and after a leak from well-known Rivals dataminer X0X_LEAK .

item.title: PlayStation Pulls Back Further From PC With End of PS Plus App
item.description: Sony is making another change to how PlayStation users access its games outside its consoles, with the company preparing to shut down the PlayStation Plus app on PC next month.

item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: There are loads of DMZ keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Used to open both locked containers and locked doors, keys are your fast-track to getting your hands on some of the best loot the extraction mode has to offer. However, when you receive a key, you're only given a brief description of where to use it, so we're going to outline where you can use every key the game has to offer.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Shuts Down Switch 2 Jailbreak in New Update
item.description: Console manufacturers and hackers have a fun game they like to play. Hackers will find a way to jailbreak a system , and the console maker will push an update that renders that jailbreak inept. The two parties go back and forth in this cycle. This is the game Nintendo is currently stuck in, and its most recent firmware update seeks to end a popular Switch 2 jailbreak.
